title: Fix migration context discovery for supported work-item file types
objective: Fix migrate-work-item-up so task context is discovered for every supported work-item object file extension by reusing centralized enumeration, add extension-complete unit coverage, and release revision 0.6.1 without public API changes.

branch.name: WI-0029-migration-context-enumeration
branch.rationale: Implementation and validation will run on a dedicated context branch before merging the bugfix and revision release into main.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-item/ bugfix to address the error. Ensure unit tests cover each supported file extension. We should be reusing the same centralized code to enumerate work item objects.

Commit the work item.

Implement the new work item, commit per task, and perform a revision versioned release, assuming no public API changes.

scope.name: centralized-object-enumeration
scope.description: Expose and reuse one centralized supported-file enumerator for work-item object traversal across discovery and migration code.
scope.reason: Independent file walkers drifted: migration included JSON while task context detection only recognized YAML.

scope.name: extension-aware-task-context
scope.description: Discover task identity and parse task context for every supported work-item object extension: .json, .yaml, .yml, .ts, and .md.
scope.reason: External BTCUSD-style JSON task records currently produce no-task-context and zero replacements.

scope.name: extension-complete-tests
scope.description: Add unit tests for each supported extension plus external JSON migration, unresolvable preservation, idempotence, sibling isolation, and read-only failures.
scope.reason: The bug crosses shared enumeration, parsing, context resolution, and bounded migration behavior.

scope.name: revision-release
scope.description: Increment the package revision from 0.6.0 to 0.6.1 and verify the compiled CLI without changing the public API.
scope.reason: This is a backwards-compatible bugfix with no new public API surface.

nonGoals.name: public-api-change
nonGoals.description: Do not change the migrate-work-item-up command or response schema contract.
nonGoals.reason: The fix changes internal enumeration/context handling only.

nonGoals.name: unsupported-extension-expansion
nonGoals.description: Do not add extensions outside the explicitly supported object set without a separate contract change.
nonGoals.reason: The bugfix must preserve a bounded, testable supported-file policy.

nonGoals.name: record-repair
nonGoals.description: Do not rewrite unresolvable historical records or invent missing task result entities.
nonGoals.reason: Migration must preserve references that cannot be resolved safely.

nonGoals.name: major-minor-release
nonGoals.description: Do not perform a major or minor version increment.
nonGoals.reason: No public API changes are requested; this is a revision release.

items.name: centralized-enumeration
items.description: Discovery and migration must reuse the same centralized supported work-item object enumeration rather than maintaining independent extension lists.
items.reason: The current migration walker sees JSON files while task context discovery silently ignores them.

acceptanceCriteria.description: One exported centralized enumerator defines and returns supported files in deterministic order, and both discovery and migration consume it.
The supported extension policy is explicit and includes .json, .yaml, .yml, .ts, and .md.

items.name: extension-aware-context
items.description: Migration task context discovery must identify and parse task records for every supported file extension while preserving current YAML/JSON parsing semantics and safe fallback for non-structured text.
items.reason: BTCUSD-0000 task records are JSON and currently produce no-task-context for every legacy reference.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A JSON task filename such as BTCUSD-0000-01000000-implement-schema-registry.json provides task context and enables safe task-qualified migration decisions.
YAML, YML, TS, and MD supported files are enumerated and tested without changing unrelated migration semantics; parse failures preserve content and report safely.

items.name: regression-and-safety-tests
items.description: Unit tests must cover each supported extension and the external error scenario, including idempotence, unresolvable preservation, sibling isolation, and read-only failure paths.
items.reason: The fix must prevent recurrence without broadening migration scope or mutating invalid records unexpectedly.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tests prove context discovery for .json, .yaml, .yml, .ts, and .md, plus a BTCUSD-style JSON whole-work-item migration fixture.
Complete typecheck, build, test, schema audit, and WI-0029 self-validation pass before task commits.

items.name: revision-release
items.description: After implementation and validation pass, increment version 0.6.0 to 0.6.1 and verify the compiled launcher reports 0.6.1 without public API changes.
items.reason: The user requested a revision-versioned bugfix release.

acceptanceCriteria.description: package.json reports 0.6.1, node ./bin/cli.js --version reports 0.6.1, final tests pass, and the migration-work-item-up public response schema remains unchanged.

items.name: task-commit-gates
items.description: Implementation, validation, and delivery tasks must be committed separately with complete evidence and zero unresolved WI-0029 references.
items.reason: The bugfix, tests, and release metadata cross separate delivery boundaries.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each task result records its passing gates and WI-0029 validates with zero invalid objects and zero unresolved references.
